title: Dichter Rundstrauch A
description: Mehrstämmiger, unregelmäßig gewölbter Uferstrauch. Elf gebogene Grundtriebe verzweigen sich rekursiv zu feinen Endzweigen mit kleinen opaken Blattsprays; dunkles Innenlaub und warme helle Olivspitzen gliedern die dichte Krone.

review.notes: Round 2: approved. The round-1 material point is fixed: the leaves are olive with darker shaded interior and lighter tops, the stems are visible through gaps, and the outline is irregular (hero, closeup_upper, closeup_base). Polish, not blocking: the few leaf-litter chips on the ground look like flat hexagons; add a little soil and grass at the stem base.
